Earn free credits

Today we are opening the Supadata rewards program. If you tell people about Supadata, we add credits to your plan.


Open Earn credits from your account menu in the dashboard and choose a task:

  • Share what you build on X, LinkedIn or Bluesky
  • Invite a teammate to your organization
  • Add the "Powered by Supadata" badge to your site or README
  • Publish a tutorial, a video or an open-source template that uses the API
  • Tell us how you use Supadata, or share a short testimonial


Already using Supadata? Your first request and your integration count. Log in and the welcome bonus is claimed for you.
    Open Rewards

    Bring your team along

    Team management is live. Invite colleagues from Settings → Organization → Members. Everyone shares one plan, one pool of credits, the same API keys and the same logs. Members use the dashboard day to day; admins also manage the plan and the team. Extra: each teammate who joins earns you a one-time credit reward!
